title: Alteration in Body Composition and Metabolic Profile During Ramadan Fasting in Healthy Men
brief_summary: One of religious duties for all healthy adult Muslims is fasting during Ramadan, the ninth month of Islamic lunar calendar. In this month, Ramadan observance fasted (no food and drink) from dawn to dusk. Studies demonstrated daytime fasting may pose a positive significant effect on metabolic health. Thus, this present study aimed to determine the effect of Ramadan fasting on body composition, metabolic profile, serum leptin and adiponectin levels in healthy men.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age 19-40 years
* Muslim men
* fasted completely during Ramadan
* no known of any metabolic-related diseases.

Exclusion Criteria:

* any diseases
* intake of any medication and dietary supplement
* smoking
* alcohol drinking
